subject: How to acces the file path of an uploaded file and use it as an argument in a function

messages.author: c2d8fd33e25d0104
messages.subject: How to acces the file path of an uploaded file and use it as an argument in a function
parts:
I am writing an app for experimental design where I need to use the file path of an uploaded csv file as an argument of a function. I can upload the file but I am struggling to pass the file path to the function. I have noticed that the once the file is uploaded it is moved into a temporary directory and think that that may be part of the problem

the function that I am trying to use is add.response(design=, response=, rdapath=)

I can upload the required files but i can't pass them to the function. design requires the name of the rda file containing the design, response requires either the name or the file path of the uploaded responses and rdapath requires either the name or the file path of the rda file containing the original design.

I have attempted to add the responses and display the design with added responses in a table using the following code:

 output$response <- renderTable({
    infile1 <- input$file1
    infile2<- input$file2
   
    if (is.null(infile1))
      return(NULL)
    if(is.null(infile2))
    add.response(design=infile2$name, response=infile1$datapath, rdapath =infile2$datapath )
     
  })

where infile2 is the rda file containing the original design and infile1 is the csv file containing the responses. I have been getting errors like the one below.


Warning in file(file, "rt") :
  cannot open file 'file1.csv': No such file or directory
Error in file(file, "rt") : cannot open the connection

When just typed into the RStudio console, the following 2 pieces of code work as intended:

add.response(design="des",response="C:/Users/Fred/Documents/resp.csv",rdapath="C:/Users/Fred/Documents/des.rda")

add.response(design="des",response="resp.csv",rdapath="des.rda")


I am not sure if this is due to me not properly understanding the reactivity aspect of a file upload or if it has to do with the uploaded file being stored in a temporary directory, because I know that the uploaded files must be in the working directory of the app in order for the function to work.

Any help or advice on this topic would be greatly appreciated.
